identification.summary: TeamT5 presented TeleBoyi at CYBERSEC 2024 as a Chinese-nexus APT that had not been publicly disclosed before [S1]. Malpedia describes it as a threat actor reportedly based in China and associated with the PlugX RAT [S2].
identification.firstObserved: Session abstract states the group has been active since at least 2014 and is still active [S1].
identification.notes: Name spelled Teleboyi (Malpedia) and TeleBoyi (TeamT5 talk title) [S1][S2]. No vendor alias is stated in the sources gathered.

attribution.confidence: TeamT5 characterizes the group as Chinese-nexus; no sponsor organization or government attribution is stated in the sources gathered [S1].
attribution.basis: TeamT5 identified a custom PlugX loader used by Teleboyi whose string decryption algorithm resembles that of the McUtil.dll loader from Operation Harvest [S2]. Links to the domain dsqurey[.]com are weak and uncertain because of the domain's registration history [S2].

targeting.notes: Targeting statements come from the conference session abstract only [S1]. Named victims are not public in the sources gathered.

capabilities.summary: Uses the PlugX RAT with a custom loader [S2].

campaigns.name: Public disclosure of TeleBoyi (CYBERSEC 2024)
campaigns.summary: TeamT5 researcher Yi-Chin Chuang presented 'Unveiling TeleBoyi' describing a previously undisclosed Chinese-nexus APT active since at least 2014 [S1].

diamond.capability: PlugX RAT with a custom loader resembling the Operation Harvest McUtil.dll loader's string decryption [S2].
diamond.victim: Critical infrastructure, especially telecommunications, across APAC, Americas and Europe [S1].

gaps: TeamT5 full report and slides (CYBERSEC 2024) were not accessible; technical detail beyond the loader similarity is unverified. A claimed JSAC 2024 talk and any exploited-CVE statements were not verified and were removed.
WebFetch could not reach any host in this run, so Malpedia and the session page were read only via search summaries.
No sponsor, objectives, named victims, campaign timeline, or exploited vulnerabilities are public in the sources gathered.
Operation Harvest and the dsqurey[.]com domain link are tentative; do not merge those clusters with Teleboyi [S2].
Mapping to a Microsoft actor name or MITRE group is not established.
